mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_item i INNER JOIN job_information j ON j.information_id = i.id

SELECT i.id, i.source, i.source_item_id, i.source_url, i.title, i.publish_time, i.first_seen_time, i.last_seen_time, i.current_version_no, j.company_name, j.salary_text, j.salary_min_monthly_yuan, j.salary_max_monthly_yuan, j.salary_months, j.location_name, j.city_name, j.experience_text, j.education_text, j.remote_type, j.job_status FROM information_item i INNER JOIN job_information j ON j.information_id = i.id
ORDER BY
i.last_seen_time
i.publish_time
j.salary_min_monthly_yuan
i.first_seen_time
ASC DESC , i.id
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{criteria.size} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}

SELECT i.id, i.source, i.source_item_id, i.source_url, i.title, i.content, i.publish_time, i.collected_at, i.first_seen_time, i.last_seen_time, i.current_version_no, i.collector_id, i.collector_version, j.source_company_id, j.source_recruiter_id, j.company_name, j.company_url, j.company_scale_text, j.company_stage_text, j.company_industry_text, j.salary_text, j.salary_source, j.salary_min_monthly_yuan, j.salary_max_monthly_yuan, j.salary_months, j.location_name, j.city_name, j.area_name, j.business_district_name, j.experience_text, j.education_text, j.recruiter_name, j.recruiter_title, j.recruiter_active_text, j.remote_type, j.job_status, j.detail_status, j.detail_collected_at, j.source_tags, j.source_skill_tags, j.welfare FROM information_item i INNER JOIN job_information j ON j.information_id = i.id WHERE i.id = #{informationId} AND i.information_type = 'JOB'

SELECT s.id, s.version_no, s.content_hash, s.title, s.content, s.standardized_payload, s.collected_at, s.collector_id, s.collector_version, s.created_at FROM information_snapshot s INNER JOIN information_item i ON i.id = s.information_id WHERE s.information_id = #{informationId} AND i.information_type = 'JOB' ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.version_no DESC
